Name: (AT)Garden Decoration lightning rod
Author: mkm0312
Description:
[size=4][size=4]
I often arrange a lot of lightning rods in a row, and I thought it would be better to make them pretty.
I used vanilla tile sheets. I also changed the color of some of them by myself.

The number of types has increased to 32 with the 1.1.0 update.
They transform into snowmen in winter, and may also be snowmen that do not melt in summer.
(Saturation is slightly reduced compared to vanilla colors.)

In 2.0.0, 23 new variations have been added.
Benches, planters, and decorative pumpkins catch lightning!


[/size][/size][list]

[/list][list=1]
